user.title: Add a constant-illuminance zone
user.description: Pick a dimmable light and the illuminance sensor that observes it. One entry per zone; add the dry and wet zones separately.

data_description.zone_name: Shown as the device name, e.g. Dry zone.
data_description.light_entity: The real dimmable light to drive.
data_description.lux_entity: Sensor that measures the light (illuminance device class preferred).

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure zone
reconfigure.description: Re-bind the dimmable light and illuminance sensor, or rename the zone. The runtime reloads with the new binding. Re-binding clears the calibration curve — run calibration again afterwards.

data_description.light_entity: The real dimmable light to drive.
data_description.lux_entity: Sensor that measures the light (illuminance device class preferred).

error.entity_missing: Entity not found in Home Assistant.
error.light_no_brightness: This light does not support brightness control.
error.light_is_virtual: That light is generated by Lux Balance itself; pick the real light instead.
error.unique_id_mismatch: The new light + sensor pair is already used by another entry.

abort.already_configured: This zone (light + sensor pair) is already configured.
abort.unique_id_mismatch: The new light + sensor pair is already used by another entry.

data_description.target_lux: Desired illuminance in lux. Only acts as the initial value when explicitly set here; otherwise the number entity's last value is restored.
data_description.scan_interval_s: Closed-loop re-evaluation period while the light is on.
data_description.deadband_pct: Adjustments smaller than this are skipped to avoid flicker.
data_description.min_brightness_pct: Lower bound for computed brightness; guards the unstable low-end LED region.
data_description.calibrate_step_pct: Sweep step during calibration (5 = fine, 10 = coarse; auto-upgrades to 10 after repeated timeouts).
data_description.auto_turn_off: Turn the light off after two consecutive cycles with ambient at or above target.
data_description.manual_slope: Fallback linear curve (added lux per 1% brightness) when no calibration has been run; 0 disables.

calibrate.name: Start calibration
calibrate.description: Run the automatic curve calibration sweep: the light steps 0-100-0%, about 15-25 minutes; keep the room unoccupied. Only one zone per bathroom can calibrate at a time - without a target only the first calibratable zone starts; target the other zone separately once it finishes.
